items.title: CXMT, Sandisk, ASML, SpaceX, D-Wave Quantum, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Chip stocks were selling off and weighing on major indexes following reports that a state-backed Chinese company has begun mass producing chip-making machines.  Those same semiconductor companies, and many artificial-intelligence names, also were under pressure Monday after Chinese memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies ’(CXMT) massive trading debut.

items.title: SNDK Just Dropped 12%: Here Is the 1 Number That Tells You Whether to Panic or Buy
items.summary: SanDisk just shed 12% in a single session, yet the stock still sits on one of the most explosive runs in the market. One operating number buried inside its earnings will tell you whether today's selloff is a gift or a warning.

items.title: Sandisk, ASML, and More Chip Stocks Hit China Roadblocks
items.summary: FEATURE  China threw up a couple of roadblocks for chips stocks Monday, forcing Sandisk ASML Holding and a host of others into the ditch. The obstacles: a massive Chinese IPO and a state-backed company’s mass production of chip-making machines.

items.title: Most Stocks Are Higher Despite the S&P 500's Reversal
items.summary: It's been a tough trading day for the S&P 500, but if you take a look under the surface, the market was actually holding up alright.  The S&P 500 was down 0.3% after trading more than 0.9% higher earlier in the session.  Chip stocks were the weakest link, with Sandisk, Coherent, and Lam Research as the index's worst performers.
